sample_unit: questions (FAQs), each answered by 11 LLMs and rated by 3 fellows

links.outcome: Clinician-rated ease of understanding of LLM answers to ovarian cancer FAQs (5-point Likert)
links.effect: Claude 3 Opus averaged 4.38, Mistral Large 4.36 and GPT-4o 4.33 for ease of understanding; readability was rated by surgical fellows, not by patients.
links.quote: Claude 3 Opus produced the easiest-to-understand answers (average score 4.38), followed by Mistral Large (4.36) and GPT-4o (4.33).

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 11 LLMs answering ovarian cancer patient FAQs across accuracy, readability, and empathy, assessed by specialist clinicians. Does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
